text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli put on a ferocious 
performance in the Takarazuka Kinen, 
capturing the crowd's rapt attention and 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by her running, Katsuragi Ace and 
Mr. C.B. challenged her to a showdown at 
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to reach even greater heights, 
Sirius Symboli rose to accept that 
challenge.
